caseName: Gulf, Colorado & Santa Fe Railway Co. v. Texas & Pacific Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Gulf, Colorado & Santa Fe Railway Company v. Texas & Pacific Railway Company
attorneys: Mr. J. W. Terry and Mr. T. J. Norton, with whom Mr. Homer W. Davis was on the briefs, for appellant. Mr. T. D. Gresham, with whom Mr. T. J. Freeman was on the brief, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Cause transferred to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, upon authority of Act of September 14, 1922, c. 305, 42 Stat. 827; Heitler v. United States, 260 U. S. 438, 439; Dayton-Goose Creek Ry. Co. v. United States, 263 U. S. 456, 478; Railroad Commission v. Southern Pacific Co., 264 U. S. 331, 344.
